name: ai-team-en
description: AI Team Starter (English) — AGENTS.md constitution, named assistants, projects with a source of truth, and a memory folder that saves lessons every session.

interface.shortDescription: Set up an AGENTS.md constitution, a memory folder and named AI assistants for your working folder
interface.longDescription: After install, Codex asks you a few questions, then writes AGENTS.md (your constitution) and a memory/ folder. At the end of each task the agent runs save-session to log the session and its lessons. Add more when you need it: add-assistant, add-project, organize-folder, add-lesson, tidy-memory, health-check.
